template.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_30_PRESENTATION_CHILD
template.inline_overrides: The F5 payload selects animation 0x001250EA and movement 0x001203C8 for this instance.

animation.name: ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE30_PRESENTATION_CHILD
animation.frames: 0x1B46 repeated four times, then paired 0x1B4A, 0x1B4E, 0x1B52, 0x1B56, and 0x1B5A entries.
animation.loop: EA at 0x00125126 jumps to 0x00125112, retaining the four-entry 0x1B46 lead-in before each cycle.

conclusion: The Type-0x30 presentation child has a six-resource template with a default movement pointer at 0x001203C0, but its presentation F5 producer overrides the instance to the fixed (+4,+2) movement loop at 0x001203C8 and the animation loop at 0x0012510A.
